drivingQuestion: How much must one eat to be counted for a zimmun — an olive-bulk or an egg-bulk?
outcomeNote: A one-segment citation header; the argument itself begins in the next unit with למימרא.

segments.en: There is a dispute in the mishna: «How much» must one eat «to obligate» those with whom they ate «in a zimmun?» An olive-bulk; Rabbi Yehuda says: An egg-bulk.
